description: Regression corpus for malformed Horizon provider error payloads. Every case is replayed through HorizonSubmissionGateway.submit(); 'rejected' outcomes are only allowed for provable definitive result codes, everything else must surface as AmbiguousSubmissionError.

submitCases.name: definitive_tx_bad_auth
submitCases.description: Well-formed Horizon 400 with a definitive transaction result code

submitCases.name: definitive_tx_insufficient_balance
submitCases.description: Second definitive code as a control

submitCases.name: tx_bad_seq_is_ambiguous
submitCases.description: tx_bad_seq is deliberately excluded: Horizon returns it both when another transaction took the sequence and when ours already applied

submitCases.name: unknown_result_code
submitCases.description: 400 with a result code outside the definitive set

submitCases.name: uppercase_result_code
submitCases.description: Result codes are matched case-sensitively; uppercase must not classify as rejected

submitCases.name: server_error_500
submitCases.description: Horizon 500 with a definitive-looking code still cannot prove rejection

submitCases.name: status_as_string
submitCases.description: response.status arriving as a string must not satisfy the === 400 check

submitCases.name: missing_response
submitCases.description: Error object without a response envelope

submitCases.name: html_error_body
submitCases.description: Proxy/load-balancer HTML error page instead of a JSON Horizon error

submitCases.name: extras_as_array
submitCases.description: extras present but not an object

submitCases.name: result_codes_as_string
submitCases.description: result_codes present but not an object

submitCases.name: result_code_as_number
submitCases.description: transaction result code arriving as a number

submitCases.name: result_code_as_object
submitCases.description: transaction result code arriving as a nested object

submitCases.name: operations_code_only
submitCases.description: Only per-operation result codes present; no transaction-level code

submitCases.name: error_is_plain_string
submitCases.description: Provider client rejecting with a bare string

submitCases.name: error_is_empty_object
submitCases.description: Provider client rejecting with an empty object

submitCases.name: definitive_with_malformed_result_xdr
submitCases.description: Definitive code still proves rejection even when result_xdr is not a string
